description: Produce human-label / value pairs while honoring a localization table. For entries declared without an explicit label the human label is resolved against a per-locale override table under the active locale, falling back to a title-cased key otherwise. Exercises an active locale with no override table at all and a locale present in the table that overrides only some entries.

cases.expected_output:
label=Value One value=1
label=Value Two value=2

label=Value One value=1
label=Second value=2
label=Value Three value=3
